title: DNA Amplification
author: Alexandra Ley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.taneide
materials: Three chloroplast and one nuclear marker were amplified.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract total genomic DNA from leaf tissue using the NucleoSpin® Plant Kit (Macherey‑Nagel, Düren, Germany) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each 20 µl PCR reaction combine: 2.00 µl 10× PCR buffer (without MgCl₂), 1.00 µl DMSO, 0.20 µl 100 mM dNTPs, 1.4 µl 50 mM MgCl₂, 0.20 µl of each 0.05 mM forward and reverse primer, 0.20 µl BioTherm Taq DNA polymerase (5 U/µl, GeneCraft, Lüdinghausen, Germany), add 1–2 µl genomic DNA extract, and bring the volume to 20 µl with nuclease‑free H₂O.

steps.title: Run PCR thermocycling
steps.instruction: Place the reactions in an Eppendorf Mastercycler (Hamburg, Germany) and run the following program: 94 °C for 3 min; then 35 cycles of 94 °C for 30 s, 50 °C for 30 s, and 72 °C for 1.5 min; finish with a final extension at 72 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Submit PCR products for sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the amplified PCR products to LGC Genomics (Berlin, Germany) for sequencing.

steps.title: Edit and align sequences
steps.instruction: Edit the obtained sequences, perform a preliminary automatic alignment with MUSCLE, then manually refine and align the sequences using Geneious version 4.8.3.
